affect--verb.def: To cause a change in someone or something.

forbidden--adj.def: Not allowed by a rule or a law.

humor--noun.def: The quality of being funny, or the ability to laugh.

discovery--noun.def: The act of finding something for the first time.

delighted--adj.ex: We are delighted with the result.

dive--noun.def: A jump head first into water, or a trip under water.

dive--verb.def: To jump into water head first, or to swim under it.

vast--adj.def: Extremely large in area or amount.
vast--adj.exTr: Önlerinde uçsuz bucaksız bir çöl uzanıyordu.

pump--noun.def: A machine that pushes liquid or air.

counter--verb.def: To reply to an argument, or to act against something.
counter--verb.ex: She countered his claim with data.

marine--adj.def: Relating to the sea and its life.

illness--noun.def: The state of being ill, or a particular disease.
illness--noun.ex: A long illness kept her home.
illness--noun.exTr: Uzun bir hastalık onu evde tuttu.

require--verb.def: To need something, or to demand it officially.

palm--noun.def: The inner surface of your hand, or a tropical tree.
palm--noun.ex: He held the coin in his palm.

analysis--noun.def: A careful study of something to understand it.

damaged--adj.def: Harmed so that it no longer works well.

height--noun.def: How tall or how high something is.
height--noun.ex: Measure the height of the door.

terrified--adj.ex: The cat was terrified of thunder.

chemical--noun.def: A substance used in or produced by chemistry.

fund--noun.def: An amount of money saved for a purpose.
fund--noun.ex: They set up a school fund.

fund--verb.def: To provide the money for something.

region--noun.def: A large area of a country or the world.
region--noun.ex: The region is famous for tea.

temper--noun.def: How easily a person becomes angry.

tragic--adj.def: Extremely sad, especially because of death.

crossing--noun.def: A place where you can cross a road or a river.

limited--adj.def: Small in amount and not able to grow.

niece--noun.def: The daughter of your brother or sister.

needle--noun.def: A thin pointed tool for sewing or injections.

delicate--adj.def: Easily broken, or needing careful treatment.

independent--adj.def: Not controlled or supported by others.

weakness--noun.def: A fault, or a lack of strength.

daisy--noun.def: A small white flower with a yellow centre.
daisy--noun.ex: The field was full of daisies.

spider--noun.def: A small creature with eight legs that spins webs.
spider--noun.ex: A spider built a web here.

northern--adj.def: In or from the north of a place.

technique--noun.def: A particular way of doing something skilfully.
technique--noun.ex: She learned a new painting technique.

wagon--noun.def: A vehicle pulled by horses, or a railway carriage.

bacon--noun.def: Salted or smoked meat from a pig.

promotion--noun.def: A move to a better job, or advertising for a product.
promotion--noun.ex: She got a promotion in March.

click--noun.def: A short sharp sound, or pressing a mouse button.
click--noun.ex: The lock closed with a click.

burst--verb.ex: The balloon burst in his hand.

permanent--adj.def: Lasting for ever or for a very long time.

packing--noun.def: The act of putting things into boxes or bags.

conduct--noun.def: The way a person behaves, in a formal style.

sheet--noun.def: A flat piece of cloth for a bed, or a piece of paper.

avenue--noun.def: A wide street, often with trees.
avenue--noun.ex: They live on a quiet avenue.

worn--adj.def: Damaged because it has been used a lot.

terror--noun.def: Extreme fear, or violence used for political aims.

misunderstanding--noun.def: A failure to understand something correctly.

tire--verb.def: To become tired, or to make someone tired.

steam--noun.def: The gas that water becomes when it boils.

closely--adv.def: Carefully, or with a close connection.

boot--noun.def: A strong shoe that covers the ankle.

conflict--noun.def: A serious disagreement or a period of fighting.

sore--adj.def: Painful, especially from injury or illness.

cattle--noun.def: Cows and bulls kept on a farm.
cattle--noun.ex: The cattle graze on the hill.

radiation--noun.def: Energy sent out as rays or particles.

register--noun.def: An official list of names or facts.
register--noun.ex: Sign the register at the door.

register--verb.def: To put a name on an official list.

turtle--noun.def: A slow reptile with a hard shell.

spoil--verb.def: To ruin something, or to treat a child too kindly.

immediate--adj.def: Happening at once, with no delay.

hunger--noun.def: The feeling or the state of needing food.
hunger--noun.ex: Hunger is still a world problem.

combination--noun.def: Two or more things joined together.
combination--noun.ex: It is a combination of luck and work.

bureau--noun.def: An office or a government department.

pillow--noun.def: The soft bag you rest your head on.

nap--noun.def: A short sleep during the day.
nap--noun.ex: He takes a nap after lunch.

announce--verb.def: To tell people about something officially.

luggage--noun.def: The bags you take when you travel.
luggage--noun.ex: Our luggage went to the wrong city.

groom--noun.def: A man on his wedding day.

lighter--noun.def: A small device that makes a flame.

drown--verb.def: To die under water because you cannot breathe.
drown--verb.ex: Two sheep drowned in the flood.

alike--adv.def: In the same way, or equally.

relative--adj.def: Compared with something else rather than absolute.

relative--noun.ex: A relative from Konya visited us.
relative--noun.exTr: Konya'dan bir akraba bizi ziyaret etti.
